verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents several public APIs. A CKS API lets you create, list, update and delete managed Kubernetes clusters. An Inference API controls gateways, model deployments and capacity claims, with Bearer-token auth, multiple transports and generated clients in many languages. A FOCUS API exports usage, and a Terraform provider covers infrastructure as code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the APIs work as documented; the FOCUS usage API is only Public Preview.
